reviews.comment: The content of the course is very interesting, but Dr. Li does not know how to teach. On top of that it is pointless to go to class since he has a very thick accent, so it is difficult to understand his explanations. In conclusion, you will not learn much from him and you will have to teach yourself everything if you want to pass this class.

Hardest class I have ever taken. First of all, the subject material is quite difficult, but the real downside is that the lectures are really unhelpful. Li is not good at lecturing, as he is very quiet, rambles, and has a somewhat thick accent. Homeworks are not easy and neither is exams.
